decision: Playwright is evidence, not the template
reason: `elementHandle.ownerFrame()` gives the frame whose document holds a fixed element, and follows the element as it moves between documents (EH-061) or is removed from the DOM (EH-060). Strider has no ElementHandle: its locators re-resolve on each use and hold no node, and the handles it has come from `evaluateHandle` on the page, which doesn't reach a frame's realm (`method-frame-evaluatehandle`), so no read returns the owning frame
